Hazrat Atta R.H farmate hain murad kashtiyan hain, isi tarah sabiqat ki tafseer mein bhi teeno qaul hain, ma'ani yeh hain ke imaan aur tasdeeq ki taraf aagay badhne wale, Atta R.H farmate hain mujahideen ke ghoray murad hain, phir hukm-e-Allah ki tameel tadbeer se karne wale is se murad bhi farishtay hain, jaise Hazrat Ali R.A waghera ka qaul hai, aasman se zameen ki taraf Allah Azza wa Jall ke hukm se tadbeer karte hain, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne in aqwal mein koi faisla nahin kiya, kanpne wali ke kanpne aur us ke peeche aane wali ke peeche aane se murad dono nafkha hain, pehle nafkha ka bayan is aayat mein bhi hai (Yauma tarjuf-ul-ardu wal-jibal) jis din zameen aur pahar kapkapa jayenge, dusre nafkha ka bayan is aayat mein hai (Wa hummilatil-ardu wal-jibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidah) aur zameen aur pahar utha liye jayenge, phir dono ek hi dafa choor choor kar diye jayenge, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain kanpne wali aayegi us ke peeche hi peeche aane wali hogi yani maut apne sath apni aafton ko liye hue aayegi, ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ agar main apne wazifa ka tamam waqt aap par durood parhne mein guzaron to? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya phir to Allah Ta'ala tujhe duniya aur aakhirat ke tamam gham-o-ranj se bacha lega.

Tirmidhi mein hai ke woh tihayi raat guzarne ke baad Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade hote aur farmate logo Allah ko yaad karo kapkane wali aa rahi hai phir us ke peeche hi aur aa rahi hai, maut apne saath ki tamam aafat ko liye hue chali aa rahi hai, us din bohat se dil dar rahe honge, aise logon ki nigahein zillat-o-haqarat ke saath past hongi kyunke woh apne gunahon aur Allah ke azab ka muaina kar chuke hain, mushrikeen jo Roz-e-Qayamat ke munkir thay aur kaha karte thay ke kya qabron mein jaane ke baad bhi hum zinda kiye jayenge? Wahb bin Munabbih (R.H / Rahimahullah) kehte hain Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke ek taraf yeh ek pahad hai, Qatadah (R.H / Rahimahullah) kehte hain Jahannam ko bhi Sahirah kehte hain.

woh aaj apni is zindagi ko ruswayi aur burayi ke saath aankhon se dekh lenge, Hafirah kehte hain qabron ko bhi, yani qabron mein chale jaane ke baad jism ke reze reze ho jaane ke baad, jism aur haddiyon ke gal sad jaane aur khokhli ho jaane ke baad bhi kya hum zinda kiye jayenge? phir to yeh do baar ki zindagi khasare aur ghaate wali hogi, kuffar-e-Quraish ka yeh maqoola tha, Hafirah ke maani maut ke baad ki zindagi ke bhi marwi hain aur Jahannam ka naam bhi hai is ke naam bohat se hain jaise Jaheem, Saqar, Jahannam, Hawiyah, Hafirah, Laza, Hutamah waghaira ab Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke jis cheez ko yeh badi bhaari, un-honi aur namumkin samjhe hue hain woh hamari qudrat-e-kamila ke matahat ek adna si baat hai, udhar ek aawaz di idhar sab zinda ho kar ek maidan mein jama ho gaye, yani Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Israfeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko hukm dega woh Soor phoonk denge bas un ke Soor phoonkte hi tamam agle pichle jee uthenge aur Allah ke saamne ek hi maidan mein khade ho jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yawma yad'ukum fatastajeebuna bihamdihi wa tazunnuna il-labithtum illa qaleela) (Surah Al-Isra: 52), jis din woh tumhein pukarega aur tum us ki tareefein karte hue usey jawab doge aur jaan loge ke bohat hi kam thehre aur jagah farmaya ayat (Wa ma amruna illa wahidatun kalamhim-bil-basar) (Surah Al-Qamar: 50) hamara hukm bas aisa ek baargi ho jayega jaise aankh ka jhapakna aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ma amrus-sa'ati illa kalamhil-basari aw huwa aqrab, innallaha 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer) (Surah An-Nahl: 77) Amr-e-Qayamat misl aankh jhapakne ke hai balke is se bhi zyada qareeb, yahan bhi yehi bayan ho raha hai ke sirf ek aawaz hi ki der hai us din Parwardigar sakht ghazabnak hoga, yeh aawaz bhi gusse ke saath hogi, yeh aakhri nafkha hai jis ke phoonke jaane ke baad hi tamam log zameen ke upar aa jayenge, halanke is se pehle neeche thay, Sahirah ruye-zameen ko kehte hain aur seedhe saaf maidan ko bhi kehte hain, Thauri (R.H / Rahimahullah) kehte hain murad is se Shaam ki zameen hai, Usman bin Abul Aaliyah (R.H / Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki zameen hai. Wahb bin Munabbih (R.H / Rahimahullah) kehte hain Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke ek taraf yeh ek pahad hai, Qatadah (R.H / Rahimahullah) kehte hain Jahannam ko bhi Sahirah kehte hain.

Lekin yeh aqwal sab ke sab ghareeb hain, theek qaul pehla hi hai yani roo-e-zameen ke sab log zameen par jama ho jayenge, jo safaid hogi aur bilkul saaf aur khali hogi jaise maide ki roti hoti hai aur jagah hai aayat (YAWMA TUBADDALUL ARDU GHAIRAL ARDI WAS-SAMAWAATI WA BARAZOO LILLAHIL WAHIDIL QAHHAR) (Surah Ibrahim: 48), yani jis din yeh zameen badal kar doosri zameen hogi aur aasman bhi badal jayenge aur sab makhlooq Allah Ta'ala Wahid-o-Qahhar ke rubaru ho jayegi aur jagah hai log tujh se paharon ke bare mein poochte hain to keh de ke unhein mera Rab tukre tukre kar dega aur zameen bilkul hamwar maidan ban jayegi jis mein koi mor tor na hoga, na oonchi neechi jagah aur jagah hai hum paharon ko chalne wala kar denge aur zameen saaf zahir ho jayegi, gharz ek bilkul nayi zameen hogi jis par na kabhi koi khata hui na qatl-o-gunah.

Ma'rifat-e-dil haq ka muti-o-farman bardar hota hai. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar deta hai ke usne apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Firaun ki taraf bheja aur mojizaat se unki ta'eed ki, lekin bawajood iske Firaun apni sarkashi aur apne kufr se baaz na aaya, bilakhir Allah ka azab utra aur barbad hogaya, isi tarah ae paighambar-e-akhir-uz-zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aapke mukhalifeen ka bhi hashr hoga. Isi liye is waqiye ke khatme par "faryad dar walon ke liye is mein ibrat hai", pas farmata hai ke tujhe khabar bhi hai? Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko uske Rabb ne aawaz di jabke woh ek muqaddas maidan mein the jiska naam Tuwa hai. Iska tafseel se bayan Surah Taha mein guzar chuka hai, aawaz de kar farmaya ke Firaun ne sarkashi, takabbur, tajabbur aur tamarrud ikhtiyar kar rakha hai, tum uske paas pahuncho aur use mera yeh paigham do ke kya tu chahta hai ke meri baat maan kar us raah par chale jo pakeezgi ki raah hai, meri sun meri maan, salamti ke sath pakeezgi hasil karlega, main tujhe Allah ki ibadat ke woh tariqe bataunga jis se tera dil narm aur roshan hojaye, is mein khushu-o-khuzu paida ho aur dil ki sakhti aur badbakhti door ho. Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Firaun ke paas pahunche, Allah ka farman pahunchaya, hujjat khatam ki, dalail bayan kiye yahan tak ke apni sachai ke suboot mein mojizaat bhi dikhaye lekin woh barabar haq ki takzeeb karta raha aur Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki baton ki nafarmani par jama raha, chunke dil mein kufr jagazin ho chuka tha is se tabiyat na hati aur haq wazeh hojane ke bawajood iman-o-tasleem naseeb na hui, yeh aur baat hai ke dil se janta tha ke yeh haq barhaq Nabi hain aur unki taleem bhi barhaq hai lekin dil ki ma'rifat aur cheez hai aur iman aur cheez hai, dil ki ma'rifat par amal karne ka naam iman hai ke haq ka tabe-e-farman ban jaye aur Allah Rasool ki baton par amal karne ke liye jhuk jaye. Phir usne haq se munh mod liya aur khilaf-e-haq koshish karne laga, jadugaron ko jama kar ke unke hathon Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko neecha dikhana chaha. Apni qoum ko jama kiya aur is mein munadi ki ke tum sab mein buland-o-bala main hi hoon, is se chalis saal pehle woh keh chuka tha ke aayat (Ma 'alimtu lakum min ilahin ghairi) (Surah Al-Qasas: 38) yani main nahin janta ke mere siwa tumhara mabood koi aur bhi ho, ab to uski tughyani had se barh gayi aur saaf keh diya ke main hi Rabb hoon, bulandiyon wala aur sab par ghalib main hi hoon. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai humne bhi us se woh inteqam liya jo us jaise tamam sarkashon ke liye hamesha hamesha sabab-e-ibrat ban jaye duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi jiske badtareen azab to abhi baqi hain, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa ja'alnahum aimmatan yad'una ilan-nar, wa yaumal qiyamati la yunsarun) (Surah Al-Qasas: 41).

(Al-Qasas: 41) Ya'ni hum ne unhein Jahannam ki taraf bulane wale pesh-rau banaye, Qayamat ke din yeh madad na kiye jayenge. Pas sahih-tar ma'ni aayat ke yahi hain ke Aakhirat aur Ula se murad duniya aur aakhirat hai. Ba'z ne kaha hai Awwal-o-Aakhir se murad us ke dono qaul hain, ya'ni pehle yeh kehna ke mere ilm mein mere siwa tumhara koi Allah nahin, phir yeh kehna ke tumhara sab ka buland Rabb main hoon. Ba'z kehte hain murad kufr-o-nafarmani hai, lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur is mein koi shak nahin. Is mein un logon ke liye ibrat-o-nasihat hai jo nasihat hasil karein aur baaz aa jayein.

Al-Qamar: 46) yani Qayamat badi sakht aur nagawar cheez hai, is din Ibn-e-Adam apne bhale bure a'maal ko yaad karega aur kafi nasihat hasil kar lega, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yauma'izin yatazakkarul insanu wa anna lahuz zikra) (89. Al-Fajr: 23) yani is din aadmi nasihat hasil kar lega lekin aaj ki nasihat use kuch faida na degi, logon ke samne Jahannam layi jayegi aur woh apni aankhon se use dekh lenge. Is din sarkashi karne walon aur duniya ko deen par tarjeeh dene walon ka thikana Jahannam hoga, un ki khorak Zaqqoom hoga aur un ka pani Hameem hoga, han hamare samne khade hone se darte rehne walon, apne aap ko nafsani khwahishon se bachate rehne walon, khauf-e-Allah dil mein rakhne walon aur buraiyon se baaz rehne walon ka thikana Jannat hai aur wahan ki tamam nematon ke hissa dar sirf yahi hain, phir farmaya ke Qayamat ke bare mein tum se sawal ho rahe hain tum keh do ke na mujhe is ka ilm hai na makhlooq mein se kisi aur ko sirf Allah hi janta hai ke Qayamat kab aayegi. Is ka sahi waqt kisi ko maloom nahin woh zameen-o-aasman par bhari pad rahi hai, halanke darasal is ka ilm siwaye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ke aur kisi ko nahin, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) bhi jis waqt insani surat mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kuch sawalat kiye jin ke jawabat aap ne diye phir yahi Qayamat ke din ke ta'ayyun ka sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya jis se poochte ho, na woh ise janta hai na khud poochne wale ko is ka ilm hai, phir farmaya ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum to sirf logon ke darane wale ho aur is se nafa unhi ko pahunchega jo is khaufnak din ka dar rakhte hain aur tayyari kar lenge aur is din ke khatre se bach jayenge, baqi jo log hain woh aap ke farman se ibrat hasil nahin karenge balki mukhalifat karenge aur is din badtareen nuqsan aur mohlik azabon mein giraftar honge, log jab apni apni qabron se uth kar mahshar ke maidan mein jama honge, us waqt apni duniya ki zindagi unhein bahut hi thodi nazar aayegi aur aisa maloom hoga ke sirf subh ka ya sirf sham ka kuch hissa duniya mein guzara hai, Zohar se le kar aftab ke ghuroob hone ke waqt ko Ashiya kehte hain aur suraj nikalne se le kar aadhe din tak ke waqt ko Zuha kehte hain, matlab yeh hai ke Aakhirat ko dekh kar duniya ki lambi umr bhi itni kam mehsoos hone lagi. Surah Naziyat ki tafsir khatam hui, Falhamdulillah Rabbil Aalameen.
